distanceMethod: Signed distance to the actual rounded-square boundary, evaluated at visible pixel centers.

placement.note: Uniform 88% bottom-aligned placement; the head and accessories retain their exact relative proportions. A narrow source-colored continuation of the existing folded wing restores the left frame entry exposed by the inset. Protect expressive features separately from intentional lower shoulder intersections.

continuation.description: Minor outer shoulder/wing continuation behind the uniformly inset approved source; only the narrow newly exposed side strip is restored. Flat source-sampled facets, no repeated edge pixels or neck stretching. All opaque placed source pixels are verified unchanged by the finisher.

intentionalEntries.note: Only the natural lower shoulder or wing root crosses the presentation outline; expressive features and retained accessories are protected separately.
